 Our Premier League campaign continues with a clash against Everton at Emirates Stadium, and you can see how we've been preparing for the contest with our latest training gallery.  
 We've won six of our opening seven Premier League games, including all three at home in N5, a record we'll be looking to extend when the Toffees come to town on Saturday afternoon. 
 After back-to-back top-flight wins, we drew a thrilling 2-2 contest with Bayern Munich on Wednesday, and while Mikel Arteta accepted the draw as a fair result from a brilliant game of football, he'll be eager to see his side get back to winning ways this weekend.
